```json { "issue": 5812, "status": "done", "branch": "claude/issue-5812-dashboard-header-collapse", "pr": "https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/5814", "premise_still_valid": true, "summary": "Premise held at origin/main: DashboardRenderer.tsx:948 rendered the header wrapper on `schema.header` alone while every child was gated on !hideHeaderText. Fixed by computing the three children (title-visible, description-visible, actions-present) as booleans first and rendering the wrapper only if one survives; the children's own conditions are unchanged. Usage sweep answered the PM's open question: `headerSection` has exactly two consumers (mobile flex column, desktop grid), both plain JSX placement, and nothing reads its truthiness -- widget indices come from schema.widgets.map, drag reorder keys off widgetIds/arrayMove, and widgets position with `gridColumn/gridRow: span` only (no explicit start lines), so removing the node costs pixels and nothing else. DashboardGridLayout has no header section, so no sibling defect. Host note: scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh reports VERDICT lock-unusable on this macOS host (no flock), so heavy runs went unlocked; --status showed the lock free and the queue empty throughout. Per charter the report lands at draft-PR time -- CI has not been waited on.", "tests": "All at head 2c20e5d63. `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/`: `Test Files 75 passed (75)` / `Tests 682 passed (682)`, exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` (tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json): exit 0 -- the first run was a false red (TS2307 Cannot find module '@object-ui/...') until `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' build` (exit 0) built the dependency closure. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard lint`: `365 problems (0 errors, 365 warnings)` -> verdict line printed `0 errors`, exit 0, all warnings pre-existing no-explicit-any. Consumer sweep over app-shell's dashboard consumers plus views/metadata-admin: `Test Files 197 passed (197)` / `Tests 2211 passed | 1 skipped (2212)`, exit 0. `pnpm changeset:check`: `No changeset declares a 'major' bump.`, exit 0. `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 4838 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).`, exit 0. Reverse verification: fix committed first, then DashboardRenderer.tsx reverted to origin/main under an EXIT INT TERM restore trap; the mutation was confirmed ON DISK by marker counts rather than an editor exit code (`const showHeaderTitle` 1->0, `schema.header.showTitle !== false` 0->1); the suite then went red in the expected direction with `AssertionError: expected
to be null` on both collapse cases -- `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)` -- while the two unchanged-behaviour cases stayed green. Restore leg confirmed by the same markers back to 1/0 plus empty `git status` and empty `git diff HEAD`. No dist/build participates: the tests import ../DashboardRenderer from source. Four new cases were added to the EXISTING header test file DashboardRenderer.headerActions.test.tsx (not a new file), pinning both directions of the contract plus the actions-under-chrome and both-flags-off legs. Changeset added: .changeset/dashboard-header-collapse-5812.md (patch, @object-ui/plugin-dashboard); scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs confirms 1 changeset for 2 released-src files.", "open_questions": [], "out_of_scope_findings": [] } ```

## PM review — **ACCEPT.** PR #5814. Diff read line-by-line against the contract; merge on CI green. ### The fix is the dispatched contract, verbatim Three visibility booleans computed first (`showHeaderTitle`, `showHeaderDescription`, `headerActions.length`), wrapper rendered only if one survives; each child's own condition unchanged (children now consume the same booleans, so the two can never disagree). `header.actions` keeps the wrapper alive under the chrome — correct, the chrome renders text, not actions. The code comment carries the measurement and the "authors had no lever" rationale, so the next editor knows why the wrapper is conditional. ### The dispatch's open question is answered with a sweep, not an assertion `headerSection` has exactly two consumers (mobile flex column, desktop grid), both plain JSX placement; nothing reads its truthiness; widget indices come from `schema.widgets.map`, drag reorder keys off `widgetIds`/`arrayMove`, and widgets position with `span`-only grid placement — so removing the node costs pixels and nothing else. `DashboardGridLayout` checked for a sibling defect: it has no header section. That was the one thing I flagged as unverified at dispatch; it is now measured. ### Verification shape - 75/75 test files (682 tests) in plugin-dashboard, consumer sweep 197 files / 2211 tests, type-check and lint clean, changeset present (`patch`, correctly scoped) and `changeset:check` green. - Reverse verification done the right way round: fix committed first, file reverted to `origin/main` under a restore trap, mutation confirmed **on disk** by marker counts (`const showHeaderTitle` 1→0, old inline condition 0→1), suite red in the predicted direction (`expected
to be null`, 2 failed) while the two unchanged-behaviour cases stayed green, restore confirmed by markers + clean `git status`. - Four new cases extend the **existing** header test file rather than adding a parallel one, pinning: collapse under chrome, collapse with both flags authored off, actions-alive-under-chrome, standalone-embed unchanged. ### Downstream Once merged, HotCRM's five dashboards lose the ~190px dead band above their filter bars with **zero app-side changes**, on the next console pin/release train — release acts stay human per the guardrails, so propagation rides the normal cadence rather than being forced from here. Source card objectstack#11329 already closed as moved; this card closes on merge via the PR.
